column1: # LOCK-AI-0001: every template of type Monster, spawned in the arena as the datapack spawns one, meeting a level 85 Phoenix Knight in Vesper heavy armour with sword and shield (vs) 80 in front of it, on the stream (1, "lock.ai.meet", npc id).

# The opponent stands still; at 10000 ms (struck), if the NPC has not yet swung or cast at it, it attacks the NPC until one of its hits lands for damage, strikes counting its swings. The case lasts 20000 ms of game time, millis counted from the opponent's arrival.

# Trace: I=intention as it changes, S<id>-<level>@<target> a skill cast begun (p opponent, s self, o other, - none), <damage>[!] and miss an auto-attack of the NPC's landing on the opponent, S<id>=<damage> its skill damage, dot=<damage> damage over time,

# o=<damage> and o=miss anything else's, P=<damage> or P=miss the opponent's strike, dead the NPC dying, opponent-dead the opponent dying. A hit for 0 damage notifies nothing; swings counts every auto-attack the NPC began at the opponent.

# firstAction is the first swing, cast or damage of the NPC's at the opponent. opponent is its HP/CP at the end, npc the NPC's HP/max HP, fromHome how far it ended from where it spawned, others how many other NPCs (minions, summons, script spawns) were around the arena at the end.
